timing: Do not sum overlapping windows, convert wall time to active time, or credit packaging/replay/waiting.
kernel: Five written stages with internal reviews; no new Lean proof or replay. Finite and high-precision controls do not prove all-n or all-policy claims.
assumptions: The declared known hard pair: P0/Q0 has n iid product-uniform threshold pairs; P1/Q1 has m=n+1 iid Joe-law pairs, c=n/m, F_c(x,y)=1-(1-xy)^c.

The observable is the exact retained endpoint skyline; coordinate-separable threshold-AND routes combine by OR. Within-vector states are unchanged and nonlatched; noiseless endpoint answers are functions of that skyline.

Fresh vectors are independent of each other and common world-independent policy randomization. A vector is charged from its first observation, including incomplete, infinite or selectively retained query words.

A common measurable adaptive policy, fixed per-world error alpha in (0,1/2), and unconditional finite-stop-and-correct probability at least 1-alpha are required. Expected lower cost is under P0; a uniform worst-case cap is at least that expectation.

Poisson processes are proof auxiliaries only. The actual experiments stay fixed-count. Restricted density domination and a separately controlled bad-area event replace naive transfer of centered Poisson moment equalities.
No finite exact real-skyline reconstruction, noisy instrumentation, unknown calibration, physical architecture, ontology or empirical warrant is supplied.
failed_controls_and_mapping_history: The local likelihood polynomial has a genuine nonglobal boundary counterexample; original author/reviewer values and wrong-coefficient controls are preserved.
Baseline exact controls reject incorrect comparable-orientation factors/subtractions and zero polynomial centering; second moments alone do not imply score L2.

Probability-source mapping retains failed DOI open (no journal-body read), unread supplementary CLT proofs and recursive spatial-Markov/indirect Zuyev limits; Fill–Naiman/Baldin overbroad mappings are explicitly rejected.
Log-four exact controls reject missing/minus singular correction and E1 rather than E0 stopped-cost orientation.

Log-squared initial reviewer run failed at an incorrect hard-coded n=1 fourth-moment expectation 92/225. Direct integration gives 23/75; the diagnostic oracle was corrected, and the retained failure log plus later passing review explain this. No accepted theorem was changed by that diagnostic correction.

Log-squared reviewer also rejected wrong mixed-moment sign, omitted empty atom, zero fixed-count compensation mean, global constant-three density comparison and incorrect singular/stopping orientation.
Two author wording inaccuracies were corrected before final digest binding: the floor(v) chain and the reason the empty-stratum density vanishes. Their history is preserved in author/review audits.
Reviewer runtime was moved from scientific CONTROL_RESULTS.json to CONTROL_RUN.log before final freeze; the final scientific replay compares every byte with no ignored timing or scientific fields.
excluded_claims: Sharp/Theta information or optimal logarithmic rate
External field-wide novelty or independent rediscovery
Protected integration, owner acceptance or T20 closure
